answer: Standing decays sharply after 5 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The ripple decay curve is applied at each close, horizon records the drop, and walnut recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks as a result finds them worthless when it returns to them. A 309 account operation therefore ties up 17 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
